title: One Hand Holds
logline: In a small moonstone workshop, a cutter grips a rough stone firmly in one hand while the other, for hours, does nothing but polish.
human_question: What does patient, unglamorous effort feel like from the inside, when nobody is watching?

premise.story: A day or more in a small lapidary or goldsmith's workshop, following one piece from a rough stone or blank to a finished, saleable piece, through the cutter's long concentration, checks under a lens, and the moment of handing over finished work.
premise.place: A small moonstone-cutting or goldsmith's workshop.
premise.experience: Close, still concentration; the small sounds of grinding and polishing; the slow emergence of shine from a dull surface.

concept_links.why: This is the concept's own image: one hand gripping a piece firmly while the other slowly polishes, an image of sustained application and effort without excitement [C021-P:L41].

The cutter's long, even concentration sits mostly with neutral feeling rather than joy or displeasure, matching the concept's account of skilled, absorbed work as one home of neutral feeling [C032-P:L75-L83].

what_camera_could_observe: A rough stone or blank held firmly
The other hand's slow, repeated polishing
Checks under a loupe or lens
The cutter's stillness over long stretches
A finished piece compared with where it began
what_must_be_real: The cutter's actual work and pace. No piece finished faster than it really takes.

possible_arc.opening: A dull, rough stone under a bare workbench light.
possible_arc.turn: The first hint of shine appears after long, unremarkable work.
possible_arc.ending_open: The finished piece is set aside, sold, or kept unfinished. Reality decides.

requirements: A working lapidary or goldsmith's workshop
A cutter willing to be filmed over the span of one piece's completion
Quiet space for close, detailed camera work

suggestions.name: A moonstone-cutting workshop near Meetiyagoda
suggestions.why: Meetiyagoda is Sri Lanka's best-known moonstone-mining and cutting area.
suggestions.verify: No workshop or cutter has been contacted; this is a plausible setting, not a confirmed location.

risks: Reducing a craftsperson to a metaphor rather than a livelihood
Slow pace may need a strong editorial hand to hold interest
drop_if: No cutter will allow filming across the full span of one piece

connections.note: The same stone traded here is cut and set there: one craft in dealing, another in shaping.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
